description:
Perform a quarterly catalog cleanup for Urban Electronics. You need to update the status and details of four specific products using the Drupal Commerce admin interface:

1. Discontinue 'Bose QuietComfort 45': Find this product and set its status to Unpublished (inactive).
2. Discontinue 'Anker PowerCore 26800': Find this product and set its status to Unpublished (inactive).
3. Mark 'Nintendo Switch OLED' for clearance: Update its title to exactly 'Nintendo Switch OLED [CLEARANCE]' and reduce its price to $279.99.
4. Update 'LG 34" UltraWide Monitor' SKU: Change the product variation SKU from 'LG-34UW' to 'LG-34UW-V2'.

Ensure no other products are modified. The admin interface is available at http://localhost/admin/commerce/products (credentials: admin / Admin1234!).
